title: pleurothallis xanthophthalma
intro: Pleurothallis xanthophthalma, commonly known as the 'Yellow-eyed Pleurothallis' or 'Yellow-eyed Orchid', is a species of orchid native to South America. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Pleurothallis xanthophthalma are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and modulate the immune system, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids have been identified in the plant, contributing to its medicinal properties.
